newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL PARANAGUA/SANTOS SUGAR SHIPPING CONDITIONS.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL PARANAGUA/SANTOS SUGAR SHIPPING CONDITIONS.

text.p: Brazil's ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping sugar.

Vessels: Catherine H. loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Amanpulo loading 27,500 tonnes sugar using big bags. Sea Duty II loading 25,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Waiting to dock, six vessels to load bagged sugar and two to load bulk.

Road: 246 trucks carrying sugar arrived on Aug 5. Loading: In July, the port loaded 101,847 tonnes using big bags and 134,938 tonnes bulk. In July 1996, it loaded 91,666 tonnes using big bags and 91,684 tonnes bulk.
NOTE: Light rain was delaying the loading of sugar at the port since Monday.

Vessels: Icarus, Seanav I, Global Star and Libanus each loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Mattz Spica loading 12,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Delta Freedom loading 13,125 tonnes sugar. Valentin Khutorsk loading 12,500 tonnes bagged sugar. APJ Angad loading 22,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Maro to load 13,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Waiting to dock, two vessels to load bulk sugar and three to load sugar (unspecified). No vessels docked at Cargill private terminal. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load bulk sugar and three to load sugar (unspecified).
Stocks: 22,209 tonnes bulk in CODESP warehouses, no bagged sugar.
Private warehouses already with bagged sugar but stock levels unavailable.
NOTE: Early rains dissipated leaving clear skies over the port.
